title: IP/ASN routing, registry and cloud-range names (ripestat, team_cymru_asn, cloud_ranges, nicbr_asn)

attributes.origin_asns: list of ASNs originating the covering prefix in BGP (more than one = MOAS: anycast, DDoS protection or a possible hijack)
attributes.bgp_announced: bool: the resource is announced in BGP (route collectors such as RIPE RIS)
attributes.related_prefixes: less- and more-specific prefixes related to the resource in BGP
attributes.iana_block: IANA delegation block covering the resource with its description (e.g. '8.0.0.0/8 Administered by ARIN')
attributes.rir: regional internet registry responsible for the resource (afrinic, apnic, arin, lacnic, ripe)
attributes.rir_registration: minimised RIR registration record covering the resource: range, cidrs, netname, status, country, created, last_modified (person objects are never kept)
attributes.registration_country: country of the RIR registration of the resource (RIR statistics): context only, never the host's physical location
attributes.abuse_contacts: abuse contact records {email, kind, authority_rank, authority, source, resource, retrieved_at, attribution} ranked for takedown requests (role mailboxes, never scored)
attributes.ptr_forward_confirmed: bool: the PTR names of the IP resolve back to it (forward-confirmed reverse DNS, resolved by the source)
attributes.announced_prefix_counts: {total, ipv4, ipv6, pivoted, capped, truncated} of the prefixes an ASN announces (every prefix counted, a capped number pivoted)
attributes.asn_neighbour_counts: {left, right, uncertain, unique} BGP neighbour counts of an ASN (left = upstream, right = downstream)
attributes.network_candidates: candidate ASNs/prefixes for a company name from a fuzzy registry search: low confidence, confirm the holder before use
attributes.data_attribution: attribution text the source's terms require for the data shown (e.g. RIPE NCC for RIPEstat)
attributes.allocated: date the RIR allocated the prefix or ASN (YYYY-MM-DD)
attributes.upstream_asns: list of upstream (peer/transit) ASNs adjacent to the origin AS in BGP
attributes.is_cloud: bool: the IP/CIDR lies in a published cloud/CDN/SaaS provider range (official provider file or cloudcheck runtime data)
attributes.cloud_provider: cloud/CDN provider of the matching range (e.g. 'AWS', 'Cloudflare', 'Google Cloud')
attributes.cloud_service: provider service of the matching range (e.g. 'EC2', 'S3', 'CDN edge', 'OCI')
attributes.cloud_region: provider region of the matching range (e.g. 'sa-east-1', 'southamerica-east1')
attributes.cloud_role: V3LUM role of the matching range: cdn_edge, shared_hosting, shared_service, shared_proxy (shared: not pivoted) or iaas, provider_network (not noise: reputation applies)
attributes.cloud_label: provider/service label shown next to the IP (e.g. 'Cloudflare CDN edge', 'AWS us-east-1 EC2')
attributes.cloud_also: other labels of the same provider range (e.g. S3 next to EC2 on a shared AWS block)
attributes.cloud_sources: datasets that supplied the cloud label (official provider files win over cloudcheck)
attributes.third_party_hosted: bool: shared CDN/cloud/SaaS front door (P378): own assets on it are third_party_hosted and never an ACTIVE network target unless the scope lists the IP or range
attributes.verdict_lifetime_days: int: days an IP-reputation verdict on this address stays valid (rented cloud compute is reassigned: at most 14)
attributes.pivot_note: why an entity is listed but not pivoted (e.g. 'not pivoted: shared CDN/cloud IP')
attributes.dataset_age_days: {dataset: age in days} of the local dataset copies a lookup used (a failed refresh keeps the last good copy)
attributes.owner_cnpj: CNPJ of the network owner in the NIC.br ASN block list (an attribute only when the owner is a network provider)
attributes.owner_kind: network_provider (ISP/hosting/telecom: customer space, no company pivot) or registrant (the organisation the network is registered to)
attributes.owner_basis: why the network owner was classified (bundled provider list, PeeringDB network type or owner-name keyword)
attributes.registered_prefix_counts: {total, ipv4, ipv6, pivoted, capped} of the prefixes registered to an ASN in a registry list
attributes.owned_networks: {match, owner, asns, prefixes, total_asns, total_prefixes, capped, candidate_own_netblocks, scope_eligible} networks registered to a company id (candidate own netblocks: analyst-confirmed, passive only)

relations.upstream_asn: IP/ASN -> upstream (transit or peer) ASN adjacent to the origin AS in BGP AS paths
relations.downstream_asn: ASN -> downstream (customer) ASN adjacent to it in BGP AS paths
relations.owns_network: organisation (company name, CNPJ) -> ASN or prefix registered to it
relations.network_provider: IP -> ASN of the ISP/hosting/telecom provider whose customer space holds the IP (the provider is not the user of the address: no company pivot, P038)
